body:
Yea, I've seen this too. It has to do with ReactFiber freezing the props to a component with `.preventExtensions()`

https://github.com/facebook/react/blob/11a1543b9ececd1fe8dbaf45df1e3ed3de5a8d9f/src/renderers/shared/fiber/ReactFiber.js#L53

The line above could be replaced with 
`const containerStyleCopy = Object.assign({}, containerStyle, leftPad)`
The info addon doesn't work with react-native to my knowledge.

I'm having the same issue with just normal react v16.0.0-rc.3
Was going to post an issue but I saw this one.

@bmv437 please open a PR if you have a chance and add that line in. We'd really appreciate it!

If not, I can take care of it as well. We just don't have a project set up to test `react@16` right now.

issue.title: Addon-info - Fix immutable props issues with React 16

repository.name: storybook
repository.description: Storybook is the industry standard workshop for building, documenting, and testing UI components in isolation

issue.body:
Fix storybooks/storybook#1890 - issue with react fiber and immutable props.

Issue: See discussion here #1890 

## What I did
I cloned the object before passing it in as props to a component (since we used to attempt to mutate the props, causing issues with react fiber)

## How to test
When using storybook with react 16 and addon-info, the Source section of the info would throw the `TypeError: "paddingLeft" is read-only` error. This PR fixes that issue.

Is this testable with jest or storyshots?
No?

Does this need a new example in the kitchen sink apps?
No

Does this need an update to the documentation?
No

If your answer is yes to any of these, please make sure to include it in your PR.

body: Opened a PR with the fix. Thanks @danielduan!

Awesome, thanks guys!

To be clear, we're not using Storybook with React Native yet, but the shared root requires us using React 16 for the web app.
